maya_customer: Hey @support_erin — our compact export for acct:acme-inc seems to be missing rows for 2025-02-12 and a few lines look garbled with � characters. S3 path: s3://redwood-exports/accounts/acme/compact/2025-02-12/part-0001.gz
support_erin: Thanks, can you paste a redacted sample line and confirm which export type (compact vs raw)? Also any invoice delta you've noticed?
maya_customer: sample (redacted): <redacted_request_id>,2025-02-12T23:58:12Z,12534,"\uFFFDutf8garble\" ,model:gptx
  -- dashboard shows ~1,215,678 tokens for that day, billing invoice shows 1,200,345 tokens (customer noticed ~15k token shortfall).
support_erin: tagging @billing_jordan and @eng_analytics_sam to investigate. Can you also confirm whether you requested the compact (deduped) export or the raw newline-delimited CSV?
eng_analytics_sam: looking. Short note: compact exporter dedups by request_id and writes gzipped ndjson-ish lines. Two hypotheses: 1) byte-level truncation of gzip chunks created an invalid UTF-8 sequence -> replacement char, 2) newline delimiter eaten causing last record of a chunk to be dropped.
billing_jordan: confirmed invoice delta ~15,333 tokens for acct:acme for 2025-02-12 vs dashboard daily rollup. Seems to align with a single lost shard.
support_erin: can you run a quick check on the raw shard contents (not the compact file) to confirm presence of the missing request_ids?
eng_analytics_sam: ran `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-exports/accounts/acme/raw/2025-02-12/part-0007.gz - | zcat | grep redacted_request_id` locally — found the request_id present in raw shards but absent in compact output.
eng_analytics_sam: quick repro steps I used:
```
# fetch raw shard
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-exports/accounts/acme/raw/2025-02-12/part-0007.gz - | zcat > /tmp/part7.ndjson
# check for missing newline / invalid utf8
python -c "import sys; import codecs
for i,line in enumerate(codecs.open('/tmp/part7.ndjson','rb')):
    try:
        line.decode('utf-8')
    except Exception:
        print('bad utf8 at', i)
"
```
eng_analytics_sam: root cause summary: exporter worker that compacts shards into the deduped export used streaming gzip concatenation. When a gzip chunk boundary coincided with a multi-byte UTF-8 sequence, our simple chunk concat logic dropped a byte, producing � in the output and sometimes losing the newline after the record. That made the dedupe step skip the record entirely.
support_erin: OK. What's the remediation / backfill plan and ETA?
eng_analytics_sam: plan: 1) run targeted re-export for the affected compact file (reassemble raw shards with safe utf8 reflow and newline fix), 2) run validation to ensure token counts match raw rollup, 3) update exporter to handle gzip chunk reassembly and add a unit/integration test. Steps/commands below and I'll kick the job.
```
# targeted re-export (support-facing shorthand)
export-worker --mode=repair --account acme-inc --date 2025-02-12 --type compact --s3-prefix s3://redwood-exports/accounts/acme/compact/reexports/ --fix-utf8
# verification
psql redwood_prod -c "SELECT count(*) FROM compact_exports WHERE account='acme' AND day='2025-02-12'";
```
export-bot: Job queued: reexport-9876 by support_erin for s3://redwood-exports/accounts/acme/compact/reexports/2025-02-12-reexport-9876.gz (ETA ~1h 45m) :gear: :hourglass: 
eng_analytics_sam: ran a dry-verify on staging: the repaired compact file restores 38 previously missing rows and token total delta ~15,420 tokens — matches billing shortfall. PR#3124 adds gzip-chunk reassembly and a regression test.
support_erin: Great. I'll keep @maya_customer posted and once export finishes we'll confirm the invoice vs dashboard reconciliation. Apologies for the disruption. :pray:
maya_customer: Appreciate the fast turnaround, plz post the new S3 path when done. :thumbsup:
export-bot: Job reexport-9876 finished: s3://redwood-exports/accounts/acme/compact/reexports/2025-02-12-reexport-9876.gz (md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e) :white_check_mark:
support_erin: We re-imported the reexport into billing rollups and ran reconciliation — post-backfill token count now 1,215,702 which is +15,357 and matches dashboard within rounding. Closing this thread after billing confirms invoice adjustments.
billing_jordan: filing invoice adjustment request for acct:acme-inc to account for restored tokens; will update once processed.
maya_customer: confirmed, saw the reconciled numbers in the dashboard. thank you! :party_parrot:
